intro: Data representation: the big ideas, key words and examples on one sheet. Keep it in your book and use it to revise (cover, write, check).

panels.title: Big questions
points: A light switch has two positions. How many different patterns can three switches make?
A lift in a building with basements needs floor −2. How could 8 switches show a negative number?
A car's mileage counter shows 999999. What happens after one more mile?
Which is easier to read aloud without a mistake: 10110111 or B7?

panels.title: Islamic foundation
panels.text: The Qur'an was revealed in clear Arabic (Yusuf 12:2). Unicode lets the Arabic script, with every vowel mark, appear correctly on screens worldwide, so the text can be read and shared accurately.
